title: Why we're skipping Black Friday
excerpt: Eight years in, an honest update on where Mully is going, and something we can't wait to show you. A note from Drew on Mully, Reserve and Mullybox 2.0.
image_alt: Mullybox 2.0: a golfer in a pink suit on a Miami course at sunset
intro: A note from Drew, Founder of Mully.

paragraphs: You're going to get a lot of Black Friday emails today. This isn't one of them. After 8 years in business, we're not doing Black Friday this year, and I wanted to tell you why.

We're a small business. We've had a lot of ups and downs, and I've always tried to be straight with you. Margins in the subscription box space have gotten really tight. It's no secret we've been pivoting from a discount subscription box model to more premium curation, and honestly, we've been working through who we are.

When I strip it all back, Mully has always been about one thing. Finding really high quality golf apparel and accessories and telling you about them. Kind of like a high end golf boutique, if one existed.
sections.quote: Kind of like a high end golf boutique, if one existed.

paragraphs: I also know the new Mully hasn't been for everyone. Reserve and the premium curated apparel aren't what a lot of you signed up for. Most of you joined for the mystery. Opening the box and not knowing what was inside.
So we've been building something that goes back to that. We're calling it Mullybox 2.0. Honestly, I think it's the reason a lot of you joined our family in the first place.
Thanks for being here since the early days.

closing: p.s. Still shopping for a golfer? [Gift a Season](/lp/gift-season) is the best gift we make.
